name: rewear-monorepo
description: ReWear - Campus Thrift & Clothing Exchange Marketplace

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "green,blue" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "green,blue" "npm start --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"

author: ReWear Engineering Team
